definitions.explanation: a formal ceremony held at schools to mark the end of a term or semester

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{終業式|しゅうぎょうしき}だ。
{終業式|しゅうぎょうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: At the closing ceremony, we listened to the principal's speech.

examples.japanese: {終業式|しゅうぎょうしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{通知表|つうちひょう}→通知表：08604_tsuuchihyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: After the closing ceremony, we received our report cards.

notes:
JAPANESE SCHOOL CEREMONIES:
{終業式|しゅうぎょうしき} marks the end of each term. Japanese schools typically have three terms per year.

WHEN HELD:
- End of first term (July)
- End of second term (December)
- End of third term (March) - this is often combined with ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧ (graduation)

TYPICAL ELEMENTS:
- ⟦{校長|こうちょう}→校長：01582_kouchou⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧ - principal's address
- {校歌|こうか}{斉唱|せいしょう} - singing the school song
- ⟦{通知表|つうちひょう}→通知表：08604_tsuuchihyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧ - distribution of report cards

RELATED CEREMONIES:
- ⟦{始業式|しぎょうしき}→始業式：08555_shigyoushiki⟧ - opening ceremony (start of term)
- ⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧ - entrance ceremony
- ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧ - graduation ceremony
